en.headline: Hang Seng closes 426 points higher at 24,211
en.dek: The index finished Friday up 1.79 per cent, extending the midday gain, with turnover at about 209.2 billion dollars.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed at 24,211.35 on Friday, up 425.56 points, or 1.79 per cent, according to market figures published after the cash session.
The index had been up 259 points at the midday close. It finished the day between a session low of 23,941.26 and a high of 24,224.05. Turnover was about 209.2 billion dollars.
The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index closed at 8,147.87, up 137.29 points, or 1.71 per cent. The Hang Seng TECH Index closed at 4,197.84, up 124.46 points, or 3.06 per cent.
Thursday's cash session had ended lower, at a three-month low. Friday's close put the benchmark back above 24,000.

zh.headline: 恒指收市升426點 重上24211點
zh.dek: 恒生指數周五收報24211點，升425點或1.79%，成交約2092億元，科指升逾3%。
body: 指數半日曾升259點。全日高低位分別為24224.05點及23941.26點，成交額約2092億元。
恒指周四收市下跌，並處於約三個月低位。周五收市後指數重上24000點。
